scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n dbs,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w binding-service" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w binding-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w binding-service && npm run typecheck -w mock-icis && npm run typecheck -w practitioner-portal
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w binding-service && npm run test -w mock-icis && npm run test -w practitioner-portal
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w shared && npx playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.demo: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:migrate:demo -w binding-service && concurrently -n icis,dbs,server,client -c yellow,magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w mock-icis" "npm run demo -w binding-service" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.demo:portal: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:migrate:demo -w binding-service && concurrently -n icis,dbs,server,client,portal,seed -c yellow,magenta,blue,green,cyan,gray "npm run dev -w mock-icis" "npm run demo -w binding-service" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w practitioner-portal" "npm run seed -w practitioner-portal"
